visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with tan skin and dark hair sits on a gray couch wearing a navy and white baseball-style shirt, holding a green paper cup with a straw. He speaks animatedly with a slight smile and points his finger upward while looking at someone off-camera. (2) He suddenly stops speaking and takes a long sip from his drink, his eyes widening and darting sideways as if realizing he said something he shouldn't have. (3) The scene cuts to a second man wearing a black baseball cap and a black long-sleeved shirt, sitting on the same couch holding a gray pillow; he looks back at the first man with a serious, questioning expression. (4) A series of fast cuts alternates between the first man continuing to sip nervously and the second man leaning in with an intensifying glare, emphasizing the tension. (5) Close-up shots focus on the first man's eyes shifting guiltily from side to side while he remains silent, followed by a final screen showing red Chinese text on a black background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 當你不小心說出來 你不應該知道的秘密. (2) [Subtitle]: 阿嘟, 你是不是跟PETER做了. (3) [Subtitle]: 你為什麼會知道. (4) [Subtitle]: 你現在馬上跟我講. (5) [Subtitle]: 快一點. (6) [Subtitle]: 誰跟你講的. (7) [Slogan]: 曹定了.
